# brew uses upstream instead of tap

Make the Brewfile install the author's fork rather than the upstream package: a formula listed by its bare name (line 56 of the Brewfile at the time, in the block of tap-provided tools) resolved to `homebrew/core`, so `brew bundle` installed the official `golangci-lint`/`goimports` instead of the versions from `kamilsk/tap` ([[DOT-169]]).

Expected: tap-provided formulae are written fully qualified (`kamilsk/tap/<name>`), so the fork wins even when a core formula of the same name exists.
